message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"h066","prompts":["I'm planning a trip across Gujarat next month and can't decide whether to take a cab or a train. Can you estimate how long the road journey from Ahmedabad to Rajkot would take, the distance, and roughly what a taxi might charge, so I can compare it against the train option?"],"rubric":["Provides an estimated driving duration between the two named cities","Provides an estimated road distance","Includes a rough taxi fare estimate with any assumptions stated"]},{"item_id":"h067","prompts":["I want my AI assistant to be able to read and update issues in our internal bug tracker through a REST API. Walk me through building a small server that exposes this as tools, in Python, following best practices for tool design, error handling, and documentation."],"rubric":["Explains the structure of an MCP server (tools, inputs/outputs)","Provides working Python code using FastMCP with at least two tools (e.g., list and create issues)","Includes guidance on error handling and tool descriptions/documentation","Does not require paid services or real credentials to run (uses a mock or placeholder API)"]},{"item_id":"h068","prompts":["I'd like to understand what a big institutional fund has been doing lately. Here is the holdings data I saved: Q1 2024 rows: AAPL 1,200,000 shares, MSFT 800,000 shares, NVDA 450,000 shares; Q2 2024 rows: AAPL 1,100,000 shares, MSFT 950,000 shares, NVDA 700,000 shares, TSLA 300,000 shares. Please summarize the number of holdings each quarter, how the positions changed, and what the shifts might suggest about the fund's strategy."],"rubric":["Correctly reports holdings count per quarter (3 then 4)","Identifies NVDA increase, AAPL decrease, MSFT increase, and new TSLA position","Offers a brief interpretation of what the changes suggest"]},{"item_id":"h069","prompts":["I have a messy log file where each line looks like '2024-05-01 14:32:07 | WARN | disk_usage | 91%' and I want to pull out the timestamp, severity, module, and value into a table. What's a good approach to parse this format robustly, including lines that might be malformed?"],"rubric":["Proposes a concrete parsing approach (e.g., regex or split on delimiter)","Handles or at least acknowledges malformed/skipped lines","Shows extracted structured output for the sample lines or equivalent"]},{"item_id":"h070","prompts":["Someone handed me an old SQLite file called routes.db and I have no idea what's inside. Can you show me how to inspect its schema, figure out how the tables relate to each other, and dump everything into JSON so I can use it in a web map later?"],"rubric":["Explains how to discover tables and columns in an unknown SQLite file","Describes how to infer relationships (foreign keys / shared keys) between tables","Produces or clearly outlines JSON output for the database contents"]}]}
